section.title: org.osgi.service.servlet.whiteboard.annotations
section.para: This package contains annotations that can be used to require the Servlet Whiteboard implementation.
Bundles should not normally need to import this package as the annotations are only used at build-time.

listitem.para: RequireHttpWhiteboard - This annotation can be used to require the Servlet Whiteboard implementation.

section.title: @RequireHttpWhiteboard
section.para: This annotation can be used to require the Servlet Whiteboard implementation. It can be used directly, or as a meta-annotation.

This annotation is applied to several of the Servlet Whiteboard component property annotations meaning that it does not normally need to be applied to Declarative Services components which use the Servlet Whiteboard.
